records.subject: Confirming cancellation for North Studio
records.body:
Hi Lin,

Confirming the cancellation on our end. We're sorry Wrenfield didn't end up being the right fit for North Studio -- the door's open if that changes.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.subject: Getting your team organized in Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Lin,

Looking to get more out of Wrenfield? Inviting your teammates is the single biggest thing that makes it click.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: You're in -- let's get North Studio set up
records.body:
Hi Lin,

Thanks for setting up North Studio on Wrenfield. If your team is more than one person, inviting them now tends to pay off -- Wrenfield is built around teammates working on shared tasks, not solo lists.

Let me know how the first week goes.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.text: :tada: New signup: *North Studio* just joined on the starter plan!

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project, no invite, no key milestone, zero tickets, and no reply to either outreach (email:d91a18ee, email:520007f7) -- entirely one-sided contact suggests low engagement. Starter plan, 8 days left. Self-serve activation possible but unlikely absent any signal of intent.

draft.subject: A hand getting North Studio's first project up
draft.body:
Hi Lin,

Following up on my note from last week -- I know the first week of a new tool is easy to put down.

Two things that usually get North Studio moving: projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so a first project is the natural starting point. And a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, which is where most of the value shows up.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your first project with you and answer anything as we go.

Best,
Priya
